scenes.text: Every night, Pip the toy robot checks the dollhouse.
scenes.imagePrompt: A tiny cute toy robot with big glowing round eyes standing in front of an old wooden dollhouse on a child's bedroom floor at night, moonlight through the window

scenes.text: Tonight, one of the little windows is lit.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up of a miniature dollhouse window glowing warm yellow in a dark bedroom, the toy robot's reflection in the glass

scenes.text: Nobody has opened that house in years.
scenes.imagePrompt: Tiny dollhouse front door slightly open, dust and cobwebs, a sliver of light inside, toy robot reaching toward it

scenes.text: Inside, every doll is sitting at the table. Facing the door.
scenes.imagePrompt: Inside a miniature dining room, five porcelain dolls sitting around a tiny table, all heads turned toward the viewer, candle light, deeply unsettling

scenes.text: There is one empty chair. It is exactly Pip's size.
scenes.imagePrompt: An empty tiny chair at the dolls' table with a small name card that says PIP, the dolls smiling, eerie rim light
